children: CTO Realty Growth, Inc. reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $46.9 million, up 24.3% from $37.8 million a year earlier, while recording a $7.1 million net loss attributable to common stockholders, compared with net income of $1 million in the prior-year quarter. The loss included an $8.4 million unrealized loss on its PINE investment.
Revenue was $46.9M, compared with $37.8M in the prior-year quarter, an increase of 24.3%.
Net loss attributable to common stockholders was $7.1M, compared with net income of $1.0M in the prior-year quarter.
Diluted EPS was a loss of $0.19, compared with earnings of $0.03 in the prior-year quarter.
Nine-month revenue increased 18.6% to $131.9 million, supported by income-property growth and higher commercial investment income.
CTO acquired three shopping centers, an outparcel and land. Its portfolio reached 22 properties across eight states, totaling 6.6 million square feet.
The company originated two preferred equity investments totaling $96.4 million and a construction loan, and sold two shopping centers for $90.7 million.
CTO said it plans to grow and diversify its income-producing portfolio, focusing on shopping centers in faster-growing markets and expected 1031 exchanges.
